symptom: component_acc ~0 although the matcher names the right component (Card filled/elevated, Button tonal/outlined/filled/elevated, Switch, TextField, FAB all matched by name); gt variant dicts carry keys the matcher never emits: mwc Button {icon:'false', style:'tonal'} vs matcher {style:'tonal'}; synth Switch {style:'on'} vs {selected:'true'}; FAB {color:'tertiary', style:'large'} vs {size:'large'}; Snackbar {style:'with-action'} vs {lines:'1'}
root_cause_hypothesis: compare._component_match requires every gt variant key to be present with the same value on the prediction, but modules C (matcher) and E (corpora component_for / synth.ref) chose different variant vocabularies. The metric measures a protocol mismatch, not mapping quality.
suggested_fix: Agree one variant vocabulary per component in fixtures/design_systems/material3.json (style, size, selected, lines...) and make mwc_corpus.component_for / synth.ref emit exactly those keys; until then read bench's informational component_name_acc (name only) for mapping quality.

symptom: divider lines are perceived pixel-exact (IoU 1.0 against gt) yet count as unmatched; with stages=('map',) on the gt IR itself node_recall drops from 1.0 to 0.83
root_cause_hypothesis: map_document sets node.type='instance' on matched subtrees (Divider, IconButton...), and compare.structural.TYPE_COMPAT does not allow 'instance' to match gt 'line' or 'icon'; so mapping *reduces* structural recall for exactly the nodes it recognises.
suggested_fix: Either keep the geometric type on the node and record the component only in node.component (matcher), or extend TYPE_COMPAT['line'/'icon'] with 'instance' (compare). Bench should then re-baseline.

symptom: two-line supporting texts and list-item headline+supporting pairs are reported as one paragraph node ('Travel plan\nModified 9:30 AM') while gt holds one node per rendered line; CER of paragraph vs line > 0.2 so each line counts as missed; bench text_line_recall (per-line credit) is 0.95+ on the same cases
root_cause_hypothesis: ocr.group_paragraphs merges aligned, same-colour stacked lines into one node, including headline (16px #1d1b20) + supporting (14px #49454f) pairs whose size/colour differ by less than para_size_tol / para_color_de; gt granularity is per line (Range.getClientRects).
suggested_fix: Emit per-line text children under a paragraph frame (keeps layout info and matches gt granularity), tighten perceive.ocr.para_size_tol / para_color_de so a 16px/#1d1b20 line never merges with a 14px/#49454f line, and/or make compare.text_recall accept per-line splits of a paragraph as the loss module already does.

symptom: badge text '53' (11px white on error container, 14x13 px) and snackbar action 'OK' (14px #1d192b on a dark inverse surface) are not found by OCR at all
root_cause_hypothesis: Vision OCR is unreliable at <= 11px (known gap of module A) and light-on-dark text on small inverse surfaces is dropped by the min_conf / min_contrast gates; the segmenter also masks nothing for them so they may be read as icon blobs.
suggested_fix: Upscale small high-contrast blobs before OCR (perceive.ocr.upscale_min_h), run OCR a second time on the inverted image for dark regions, or treat 1-3 character glyph groups inside badge-sized ellipses as text candidates.

symptom: page with an open md-dialog: color_de 40 (before discounting the scrim rect: perceived root fill #ece6f0 vs gt scrim #000000 a=0.32), frac_bad 0.23, mean_de 4.7; the re-render has no scrim, the dialog surface becomes a large grey box offset to the left and the cards under the scrim keep their blended colours
root_cause_hypothesis: perceive has no translucent-overlay model: the scrim-darkened background and cards are segmented as opaque regions of the blended colour, the dialog surface merges with neighbouring darkened cards whose blended fill is within perceive.seg.fill_tol, and the IR has no node with alpha<1.
suggested_fix: Detect a uniform darkening (ratio of blended/unblended colours constant over a large area touching the viewport) and emit a full-page rect with alpha; segment the dialog region against its own fill; bench already strips translucent gt fills from the colour metric so the remaining penalty is geometric.

symptom: 20x20 gt 'vector' nodes (inline svg icons in md-icon-button / checkbox) carry fill #ffffff while the perceived icon colour is #49454f or #6750a4 (dE 70-79); color_de mean 8.3 on mwc vs 0.0 on synth
root_cause_hypothesis: mwc_corpus extraction takes 'the first shape's fill else stroke' of an inline svg; Material Web icons start with a transparent/white path so the gt colour is the wrong shape's fill, not the glyph colour.
suggested_fix: In extract_script pick the first shape with a non-transparent fill/stroke that differs from the background (or the dominant painted colour of the svg), and let compare exclude vector/icon pairs from color_de or compare them with a thin-stroke tolerance.

symptom: every md-*-button / md-fab host frame in gt has radius (0,0,0,0) while the perceived pill has r=20 (FAB 16-18); radius_mae is 5-7 px on pages full of buttons
root_cause_hypothesis: Material Web paints the rounded surface on an inner element/pseudo, so the gt host frame is unpainted and square while its painted child rect carries the radius; perception merges host+paint into one node and is matched to the host.
suggested_fix: mwc_corpus.build_document should lift the paint (fill/stroke/radius/shadow) of a single full-coverage painted child onto an unpainted host (as the matcher's bg_child_iou rule does) or structural_metrics should compare radius against the gt node's paint child; synth already encodes paint on the component frame and scores 0.36 px.

case: mwc/* (109 frames in 5 pages), synth/* (25 frames)
symptom: unpainted containers are never produced: standard icon buttons (22 missed), text buttons (16), 2-line list items (26), tabs (10), radios (8), md-list wrappers (9), top app bars (4); node_recall 0.49 on mwc / 0.66 on synth although painted regions match at IoU 0.83-0.86
root_cause_hypothesis: hierarchy.build_tree only nests detected regions and text; nothing synthesises a grouping frame around an icon+label cluster, a repeated row of (icon, headline, supporting, trailing control) or a tab strip, so component-level nodes without their own paint have no counterpart.
suggested_fix: Add a grouping pass in perceive (gap-based clustering of siblings into rows/items with consistent padding; repeated-structure detection for lists) emitting transparent frames, and let the matcher propose Button/text, IconButton/standard, ListItem and Tab candidates for them; weight these as 'inferred' in the decision queue.

case: synth/synth_1_000, mwc/* (34 gt icons missed, 28 extra pred icons)
symptom: icon pairs match at IoU 0.5-0.62 (borderline) or not at all: gt md-icon boxes are 24x24 font boxes, perceived icon boxes are the glyph ink (16-20 px); icon_name is None so re-rendered icons are blank (visible in every diff image)
root_cause_hypothesis: perceive reports tight ink boxes while gt uses the element box; compare.struct.iou_thr=0.5 is on the edge for a 18x20 ink box inside a 24x24 host; no glyph identification exists yet.
suggested_fix: Expand icon regions to the inferred em box (ink height * 24/20 for Material Symbols, centred) in segment/hierarchy, and add a template match against rendered Material Symbols glyphs to fill icon_name (mapping or perceive); consider a type-specific IoU threshold for icons in compare.

symptom: an empty outlined text field (1px #79747e stroke, floating label straddling the top edge) is re-rendered as a solid dark grey (#79747e-like) box; mean_de 5.0, frac_bad 0.11
root_cause_hypothesis: segment.classify_component picks the fill among a band inside the outline / eroded interior by 'largest consistent core'; for an empty box whose interior equals the page background the outline colour wins (background-coloured interior is treated as 'not the region'), producing a filled rect with the stroke colour.
suggested_fix: When the eroded interior equals the parent background, emit fill=None + stroke (hollow region) instead of a filled rect; add a hollow/outline-only case to tests/test_perceive.py with a floating label crossing the stroke.

case: mwc/mwc_1_002 (TopAppBar matched as Tabs), mwc/* (Snackbar variant)
symptom: a small top app bar (title + 3 trailing icon buttons, 64px) resolves to Tabs{icon:'true', type:'primary'}; Snackbar resolves but with variant {lines:'1'} where gt says {style:'with-action'}
root_cause_hypothesis: TopAppBar and Tabs signatures overlap (full-width 48-64px row of icons/text, no fill against surface); children-pattern scoring is greedy and the title text role (title-large 22px) is weighted only 0.75, so the icon count dominates.
suggested_fix: Give TopAppBar a critical text-role constraint (title-large/medium leading text) and Tabs a 'repeated equal-width text/icon cells + 2-3px indicator line' child pattern; align Snackbar variant keys with the corpus.

case: mwc/* (render-only oracle: gt IR -> render vs real page, mean_de 0.57, worst mwc_1_005 2.11)
symptom: with ground-truth IR substituted for perception, every text line re-renders ~2px lower than the Material Web original (heat map outlines every glyph)
root_cause_hypothesis: mwc_corpus text boxes are Range.getClientRects content areas (~1.17em tall) while text_style.line_height carries the CSS line-height (e.g. 20px for 14px text); the renderer centres a 20px line box in a ~16px div, pushing glyphs down by (lh - content)/2
suggested_fix: IR contract: a text node box is its line box(es) (height = lines x line_height). In mwc_corpus, expand each text box vertically by (line_height - content_height)/2 on both sides (or set line_height to the content height), and assert in tests that render(gt) reproduces the page text at <=0.5px offset

symptom: render-only oracle draws the menu surface UNDER later siblings (text fields), so field labels/values paint over menu items
root_cause_hypothesis: GT paint order uses (stacking layer, pre-order); md-menu renders as a popover/top-layer (or position:fixed with z-index) that our layer assignment misses, so it keeps DOM order
suggested_fix: in EXTRACT_JS treat :popover-open, [open] md-menu surfaces, position:fixed/absolute with z-index>0 and <dialog open> as top-layer; reorder their subtree after all in-flow content

case: all (oracle: gt IR -> map vs gt)
symptom: even on perfect IR the matcher scores 0.11 component+variant accuracy and drops node_recall to 0.91
root_cause_hypothesis: variant vocabulary mismatch and instance retyping (being fixed in round 3: variants-gt, metrics-gate)
suggested_fix: re-measure the oracle after round 3 merges; target component_acc >= 0.8 on gt IR

case: mwc/* and synth/* (ListItem 101, IconButton 47, Button 40, List 26, TopAppBar 16, Tab 15 missed gt frames)
symptom: unpainted containers were never produced: node_recall 0.57 although painted regions matched at IoU 0.83
root_cause: hierarchy.build_tree only nested painted regions and text; nothing inferred list items, lists, text/icon button targets, tabs, app bars or destinations from sibling geometry
fix: new dt/perceive/group.py called at the end of build_tree (perceive.group.enabled): glyph-fragment clustering, recursive XY-cut into bands with column cuts, M3 box rules (item heights 56/72/88, 40x40 icon buttons, 40px text buttons with 12px padding, equal-width tabs, 64px app bar, 80px nav bar), frames clipped so they never cross a painted sibling

symptom: same change measured on precision and composite
root_cause: inferred frames are matched by gt component frames (ListItem, IconButton, Button, Tab, TopAppBar, List)
fix: precision guards: rows packed tighter than an M3 item (centre pitch < item_min_fill x snapped height) are not list items; a row whose texts are all accent labels is a button row; fixed-size frames clipped below min_keep_frac are dropped; nav-bar labels without icons are not tabs; lone accent text on the page is not a text button

case: synth/synth_1_000 app bar (and every synth app bar)
symptom: 40x40 icon-button frames around app-bar icons are unmatched on synth (26 extra frames) but matched on mwc (35 IconButton/TopAppBar hits)
root_cause: synth grammar puts bare 24px icons directly in TopAppBar while Material Web wraps each in md-icon-button (40x40 target); the two ground truths disagree
fix: kept the M3-correct icon-button target (perceive.group.appbar_icon_buttons, default True: +0.016 recall, -0.011 precision); suggest the synth grammar wrap app-bar icons in IconButton frames

symptom: an inferred list frame at IoU 0.97 with the gt List is reported unmatched and the gt List is missed
root_cause: map turns perceived dividers into type 'instance' (Divider) and compare.structural TYPE_COMPAT['instance'] excludes 'line', so in the Hungarian assignment (more pred rows than gt columns, every column filled) the divider takes the gt List column (cost 0.996) and pushes the list frame onto a gt divider line
fix: not fixed here (compare/mapping not owned): add 'line' to TYPE_COMPAT['instance'] or keep orig_type for matching, or drop pairs below iou_thr from the cost matrix before assignment

case: tests/test_perceive_group.py text-button row at an 8px gap
symptom: three adjacent text buttons ('Archive', 'Discard', 'Reply all') come back as one OCR line, so no per-button frame can be inferred
root_cause: Vision merges words of one baseline across a 32px label-to-label gap; text nodes carry only the paragraph ink box, not word boxes
fix: not fixed (ocr.py not owned): split OCR lines at word gaps >= ~1.5 x size or keep word boxes in text node meta so group.py can split button rows; test uses a 24px button gap

symptom: map_document on the gt IR dropped node_recall from 1.0 to 0.826 (4 dividers, 2 lists, screen, label-bg unmatched); bench node_recall 0.5685 counted recognised components as misses
root_cause: the mapper sets type='instance' (keeping meta.orig_type) and compare.structural.TYPE_COMPAT['instance'] excluded line/icon/vector, so a Divider instance could not match its gt line and the Hungarian assignment then displaced neighbouring frames
fix: match_nodes / type_acc use geom_type(node) = meta.orig_type for instances; a bare instance is compatible with every non-text shape

symptom: type_acc 0.82 although matched pairs had identical geometry
root_cause: type_acc compared node.type, so every mapped instance counted as a type error against its gt frame/rect/line
fix: type_acc compares geom_type (orig_type of instances)

case: mwc/* and synth/* paragraphs (headline + supporting lines)
symptom: a perceived multi-line paragraph covering two gt lines counted as missing both lines (CER of paragraph vs line > 0.2); text_recall 0.916 vs text_line_recall 0.95+
root_cause: text_recall compared whole pred node text to each gt line
fix: line-fair text_recall: split pred text on newlines, credit a gt line when a part has CER <= compare.struct.text_match_cer and the part's band (paragraph box split evenly per line) overlaps the gt line vertically by > compare.struct.line_band_overlap; text_cer unchanged; icons use max(IoU em box, IoU meta.ink_box) when gt carries ink_box

symptom: composite ignored the independent validator: a render could fail every VALIDATION.md gate and still score well on IR metrics
root_cause: bench only folded dt.compare pixel metrics (mean_de, frac_bad, ssim) into the composite
fix: bench.fidelity_metrics adds jnd_frac_nontext (norm 0.3, w 1.0), chamfer_tile_max (norm 128 px, w 0.5) and edge_within1 (w 1.0) from dt.validate.fidelity per case (gt text boxes as the text mask, no OCR); METRICS_VERSION=2; composite old definition 0.7237, new 0.7475 (0.7482 without fidelity)

case: all corpora (chamfer_tile_max mean 104 px, worst 511 px)
symptom: worst-tile edge chamfer is 40-500 px on every case, far beyond the 1-2 px validation gates
root_cause: a tile whose element is absent from the render scores the distance to the nearest render edge anywhere; icons re-render blank (no icon_name) and unpainted containers are missing, so the max over tiles is dominated by missing elements rather than misplacement
fix: normaliser bench.norm.chamfer_tile_max set to 128 px so the metric keeps a gradient (goodness 0.37 today); expect large gains once icon identification lands

symptom: the gate lived in git-ignored out/bench/baseline.json with a single 0.01 tolerance and treated a missing baseline as PASS; limit/missing files dropped cases silently and a crashed worker aborted the whole run
root_cause: gate not shipped with the repo; scan of corpora filtered silently; ProcessPoolExecutor.map re-raised the first worker exception
fix: dt bench --set-baseline writes tracked knowledge/baseline.json (metrics_version, stages, n_cases, case ids, weights, norms, composite, per-metric goodness); dt bench --gate fails on composite drop > bench.gate.eps (0.003), any goodness drop > bench.gate.metric_eps (0.01), incomparable runs or a missing baseline, printing a per-metric delta table; report.json lists dropped and errored cases; worker crashes become error rows

symptom: empty outlined text field rebuilt from 3-4 loose 1px bars (right edge lost) instead of one stroke-only rect; radius of the sibling 'Email' field read as 2 instead of 4
root_cause: the floating-label background cuts a gap into the top edge that the padded OCR box does not fully cover (1px), so binary_fill_holes finds no hole, the ring is classed flat/split; radius was fitted on the >bg_dist mask whose faint antialiased corner pixels square the corners off
fix: segment._open_ring_fill: ink concentrated within stroke_max of the bbox edges with every side >= ring_side_cov covered -> convex hull closes the gap; hollow branch rejects ring widths > stroke_max, compares interior to the parent bg (rgb fill_tol or Lab hollow_bg_de) and measures radius on 50%-coverage ring pixels (_ring_shape)

symptom: dialog surface touching scrim-darkened cards formed one 725x713 component classed as a 'bordered box' with a 115px stroke (later as an image), painted as a light slab over the page; frac_bad 0.229, mean_de 4.71
root_cause: the hollow branch accepted any ink_ratio < hollow_frac without checking that the ring is stroke-thin; mixed components whose largest flat core is a small fraction of the hole-filled area went to image/textured instead of being split
fix: ring width must be <= stroke_max for the hollow branch; _large_flat_core finds the largest solid single-colour blob (area >= split_min_area, bbox solidity >= split_core_solid, among split_colors most frequent ink colours) and the split path emits it before the image test; remainder recursion now requires strict progress (fixes a RecursionError on mwc_1_005)

symptom: no translucent overlay in the IR: root fill = darkened bg #aca8ad (color_de 9.6 vs gt #fef7ff), cards keep blended colours, no node matches the gt scrim rect
root_cause: segmentation has no model of a uniform full-page blend; every darkened surface is read as an opaque colour of its own
fix: segment.detect_scrim: fit one alpha toward md.sys.color.scrim that explains the border-ring bg as a known surface role (residual <= scrim_fit_tol, alpha in [scrim_alpha_min, scrim_alpha_max]); require >= scrim_min_samples other frequent colours that un-blend to known M3 roles (or to colours seen un-darkened) within scrim_known_de and >= scrim_clear_frac of colours that cannot be darkened (the dialog). estimate_background returns the true page colour, find_regions segments against the observed one and emits a full-page scrim Region (fill alpha, meta.scrim) plus meta.under_scrim/true_fill/true_stroke or meta.scrim_clear on every region; apply_scrim(root) re-stacks a built tree (under-scrim subtrees with true colours below the scrim, clear nodes above)
metric: mwc_1_002 composite / color_de; component_acc with apply_scrim wired in

symptom: 16px #1d1b20 headline and 14px #49454f supporting line merged into one paragraph node; the supporting line's colour was estimated as #1d1b20
root_cause: _refine_line crops raw box +0.45h vertically, reaching the darker line above; glyph_coverage takes fg from the pixels farthest from bg in the whole crop, so the neighbour's colour won and the colour gate (para_color_de) could not separate the lines; sizes 15.9 vs 14.5 sit inside the 1px ink quantum
fix: ink-band selection (_line_band: empty-row bands, merge gap band_merge_gap x tallest, keep the band with most ink in the OCR columns) + fg re-fit on the line's own band (fg_refit_de); para_color_de 6->5, para_size_tol 1.5->1.4 (just above the 1.33/1.39px asc/cap quantum, lower splits same-size paragraphs)

symptom: 'Reminder: ...' 14px measured as size 45 and merged with 'Location history'
root_cause: Vision merged a tall leading list icon ('•') into the line; its 56px box made the ink measurement span two text lines
fix: _line_band keeps only the line's own ink band

symptom: 11px white badge digits on #b3261e pills never OCR'd
root_cause: full-image Vision pass drops tiny high-contrast text; badges anchored on icons form one glyph-edge blob with the icon
fix: second-chance OCR: uncovered glyph-edge blobs (morph gradient >= sc.edge_thr, closed by sc.join_px) OCR'd as x3 upscaled crops (inverted first on dark bg), bounded by sc.max_crops; unreadable blobs searched for filled sub-shapes with holes (badge on icon); _refine_line_inner re-measures glyphs inside a solid container so size/colour are the digits' (11.3px, white)

symptom: plainly legible 22px title / 2-letter button label / avatar initial missing from OCR
root_cause: Vision full-image text detection silently skips some isolated short texts; on a crop it reads them with conf 1.0
fix: same second-chance pass (crop OCR of uncovered text-like blobs)

symptom: crop-level (and isolated full-image) OCR reads icons as 'Do', 'OJ', 'J' with conf 1.0
root_cause: Vision confidence is not informative for icon glyphs
fix: plausible_text_geometry: ink width / approximate Roboto width of the recognised text at the ink-derived size must be in [sc.width_ratio_min, sc.width_ratio_max]; applied to all second-chance lines and to full-pass lines with <= short_alnum alphanumerics (rejected ones become icon_words). Digit-only lines use the ink bottom as baseline ('4'/'7' crossbar fooled the row-drop baseline)

symptom: 'OK' recognised as Cyrillic 'ОK' (CER 0.5)
root_cause: Vision with language correction off returns Cyrillic/Greek homoglyphs
fix: normalize_homoglyphs maps look-alikes to Latin when the line has no other non-Latin letters

case: mwc/* wrapped 2-line bodies ('Attached is the latest draft for your / review.')
symptom: still one paragraph node vs gt per rendered line
root_cause: same size and colour: indistinguishable from an authored multi-line paragraph (tests/test_perceive.py::test_paragraph_line_height requires grouping); gt granularity is per client rect
fix: not changed (intended granularity); text_line_recall credits per-line splits. A compare-side per-line match or per-line text children would be needed to close this

symptom: component_acc 0.06 although the matcher named Button/Card/Switch/FAB correctly: gt variant dicts carried keys the matcher never emits (Button icon, Switch style on/off, FAB color/style/lowered, Checkbox state, Chip style/elevated, Snackbar style, ListItem leading/trailing, TopAppBar style vs size)
root_cause: mwc_corpus.component_for, synth.ref and the material3 catalog each invented their own variant vocabulary; compare requires every gt key to be present with an equal value
fix: one vocabulary per component in dt.mapping.material3.VARIANTS (shipped as meta.variants in material3.json, documented in docs/VARIANTS.md); corpora build refs via material3.component_ref (validated), matcher projects every match with DesignSystem.normalize_variant; sub-parts (List, ChipSet, Tab, MenuItem, SelectOption) become meta.part

case: mwc/* buttons, FABs, chips, switches, text fields, menus
symptom: gt md-* host frames are unpainted squares (radius 0) while perception sees the painted pill; radius_mae 4.4 px on mwc vs 0.34 on synth; the painted child and the host compete for one perceived node
root_cause: Material Web paints the surface on an inner element (div.background, span.outline, button.fab, ::before track); the DOM walker emitted the host and the paint child as separate nodes
fix: mwc_corpus._lift_paint: an unpainted md-* host takes fill/stroke/radius/shadow of a child covering >= selftest.mwc.lift_cover (0.9) of it (plus a separate covering outline), the child is removed and its children re-parented, meta.lifted_from records it, and the host inherits the paint's stacking layer (meta.z) so occlusion flags do not change

symptom: after paint lifting, 5 texts under the open menu lost meta.occluded and text_recall fell 0.9156 -> 0.9106
root_cause: the lifted paint came from div.items (z-index 20, meta.z 21) but the host keeps meta.z 1, so _flag_occluded no longer saw the menu surface as painted above the form
fix: _lift_paint copies the larger meta.z of the lifted child onto the host

symptom: gt 'vector' colour #ffffff for md-radio while the ring is #6750a4 / #49454f
root_cause: svgColor took the first shape's fill, which is the white <rect> inside the radio's <mask>
fix: skip shapes inside mask/clipPath/defs/pattern/marker/symbol and shapes whose colour is within selftest.mwc.backdrop_de of the backdrop (elementsFromPoint under the svg, then ancestors, then page); fall back to the svg's own color only if it differs from the backdrop, never to white

symptom: gt icons are 24px font boxes while perceived icons are the 16-20 px glyph ink, so icon pairs sit near the IoU 0.5 threshold and nobody can tell which box is meant
root_cause: the extractor only had the element box
fix: md-icon keeps the font box as box and records meta.ink_box (canvas measureText actualBoundingBox* around the Range-rect baseline); 86% within 1px of the pixel ink, the rest are icons under badges or nav pills
metric: icon ink box edge error (px, median)

symptom: 64px top app bars (title + 1-4 action icons) resolved to Tabs{icon:true,type:primary}; center-aligned bars resolved to TopAppBar small
root_cause: Tabs and TopAppBar signatures overlapped (full-width 48-64px rows of icons/text); the title text role was weighted 0.75 and nothing described a tab strip's structure or the title placement
fix: new Signature constraints: critical (extra critical constraint names), cells='equal' (>= 2 equal-width cells), indicator=(lo,hi) (thin bottom line anywhere in the subtree; 3px primary, 2px secondary), title_align start|center (relative to the bar or to the free span between neighbours); TopAppBar text/text_count critical, Tabs cells/indicator critical

case: synth/* (filled text fields, unselected switches, square FABs)
symptom: filled TextField -> Snackbar/SearchBar, unselected Switch -> no component, square FAB with its icon OCR'd as '+' -> FAB extended
root_cause: Snackbar's inverse-surface fill matches #e6e0e9 in the dark scheme and its height range spanned 56px; perceive absorbs the switch's 2px outline into a halo (shadow) so 'stroke' and 'shadow: none' both failed; the extended FAB's aspect constraint only weighed 1
fix: Snackbar heights discrete (48 or 68) with action true/false variants; filled TextField shadow 'any' and its pattern accepts the active-indicator line; Switch shadow 'any', unselected stroke 'any'; extended FAB aspect weight 3; ListItem text and children critical; Select spec (arrow is the only required atom)

case: mwc/* and synth/* dividers (60 gt nodes)
symptom: perceived dividers (IoU 1.0) are mapped to Divider, become type 'instance' and then count as unmatched: compare.structural.TYPE_COMPAT['line'] has no 'instance'
root_cause: contract mismatch between matcher (matched nodes become instances, relied on by tests/test_cli.py and the Figma export) and compare's type gating
fix: new param map.keep_geom_types (default '' keeps the contract); setting it to 'line' (or adding 'instance' to TYPE_COMPAT['line'] in dt/compare/structural.py) is left to the compare/CLI owners

symptom: the shipped screenshot showed corrupted glyphs in 'alex@example.com' (OCR read 'alex@ex-mple.com'); the regenerated render with identical gt geometry is clean
root_cause: a one-off render glitch at corpus build time (font raster), not reproducible
fix: corpus regenerated (seed 1, n 12, same ids); mwc screenshots are byte-identical to the previous ones

symptom: geometry nearly exact (chamfer 0.51px, edges within 1px 92%) but 19% of non-text pixels are past JND: the whole page background is ~2.5 dE2000 off
root_cause_hypothesis: root fill estimated from border sampling (white app bar vs lavender page); refine never recolours the root because per-node own error is below refine.critic.min_node_de even though the error mass over the page is huge
suggested_fix: background = mode of pixels not covered by any detected region; and a recolor hypothesis for any node whose error MASS exceeds min_err_mass, sampling the dominant target colour under the node minus children, accepted only if loss drops

symptom: 4 of 6 custom 4-point sparkle bullets (~10px) are unnamed icons and render as nothing
root_cause_hypothesis: not a Material Symbol at acceptable dE, so icon_name stays None; the as-is raster fallback requires min_side 20px
suggested_fix: for unnamed icon nodes allow rasters down to ~6px (an unidentified glyph is an asset), still subject to the texture and budget guards

symptom: a pale illustration card (#f3edf7 on #fdf7fe) with 6px button labels loses its card background and tiny labels in the render

symptom: render(gt) drew every mwc text line ~2px below the Material Web page; heat map outlined every glyph

symptom: slider inactive track rendered in the active colour across its full length; with ticks the tick-dot pattern became solid 4px bars; once 0px elements' pseudos were emitted the hidden value label became a 28px disk

fix: clipInset() resolves inset() (px, %, calc via a probe element) and shrinks pseudo boxes; gradients with any transparent stop are not fills; elements with a singular transform are not visited. Tests: test_mwc_slider_active_track_is_clipped, test_mwc_slider_ticks_and_hidden_label

case: mwc/mwc_1_000 gt IR rendered on a 48x48 canvas (adversarial)
symptom: a 48x48 render of a 600x891 page passed pixel-exact, visually-identical and structurally-faithful and scored bench composite 1.000 (gt IR itself: 0.976)
root_cause: dt.validate.validate and bench pixel/fidelity metrics cropped target and render to their common size (dt.common.image.same_size), so only the top-left 48x48 of the target was ever compared
fix: validate.fidelity.conform_to_target pads a smaller render to the target frame with one flat colour opposite to the target (a per-pixel inverse would reproduce the target's edges: edge_within1 stayed 0.75) and crops a larger one; size_match gates every tier; bench scores on the conformed render and multiplies the case composite by the canvas IoU (frame_iou)

symptom: a doc that is a single raster of the target passed all three validation gates (pixel-exact included); without meta.rasterised its raster_frac was even reported as 0
root_cause: editability was only enforced through text_under_raster (doc text nodes under a crop); a raster with no text nodes left, or an image_ref crop not flagged by the critic, was invisible to the gates
fix: raster_nodes = every painted image node with image_ref (flag or not), raster_frac = union mask (not a sum of boxes); every tier requires raster_frac <= validate.gate.raster_frac (0.35 = the critic's own budget)

root_cause: the composite had no editability term, and structural metrics counted nodes that paint nothing (transparent text, opacity 0, children of hidden parents)
fix: case composite x (1 - bench.raster_penalty * raster_frac) (raster area outside gt images; 0 for every real pipeline output, so the baseline is unchanged); compare.structural._nodes walks paint semantics (hidden/zero-opacity subtrees and text with alpha <= compare.struct.min_paint_alpha are skipped)

case: adversarial: @2x card (dpr=2), nested cards 3 deep, translucent overlaps, 60-row list; real: gws_keep, m3_lists_*
symptom: flex re-render moved children by up to 101 px vs the absolute render (left-aligned card body jumped to the card centre; indented nested card collapsed 16-32 px onto its parent's edge; 60-row list drifted 4-5 px); bench layout_consistency still read 0.997 because it is an image-mean dE

fix: keep the true padding; _cross_align returns None when no alignment displaces every child by <= tol (centre error = spread/2); simulate flex placement (_flex_drift) and drop the layout when any child lands > perceive.layout.max_drift px from its absolute box; tests/test_perceive_layout.py checks DOM rects flex vs absolute with the real renderer

root_cause: macOS-only OCR deps were unconditional in pyproject; the non-Vision backend was only a README hint
fix: sys_platform == 'darwin' markers on pyobjc; [project.optional-dependencies] linux/ocr = rapidocr-onnxruntime>=1.4; scripts/setup.sh picks the extra by platform

case: fresh clone (git archive of main @ 00b4c09) + pytest
symptom: test_corpus_pngs_exist_open_and_match_manifest fails ('only 0 successful reference screenshots'); every test using out/mwc_test.{html,png} is silently skipped, including in agent worktrees
root_cause: fixtures/screens/*.png and out/ are git-ignored; out/mwc_test.html was hand-made with absolute file:// paths into one checkout and nothing could regenerate it
fix: scripts/make_reference_page.py regenerates the page for the current checkout (pixel-identical PNG, max diff 0); the screens test skips only when no PNG was ever captured (a partial set still fails); dt doctor reports both with the fix command

case: DT_OCR=rapidocr on fixtures/screens (gws_calendar 'GoogleWorkspace', gws_gmail 'Al-powered,secure,andeasytouse') and rendered lines ('JoinwithGoogleMeet')
symptom: RapidOCR (PP-OCR rec) drops most word spaces on Latin text, word boxes were an even split of the line; GT bench text CER 0.021 vs 0.003 with Vision
root_cause: the CTC recogniser has no explicit space modelling at UI sizes; adapter passed text through and invented word boxes
fix: request per-character boxes (return_word_box), measure the line's ink column gaps, accept a gap as a word gap if >= 0.24 x ink height, >= 1.8 x the line's median letter gap and >= median + 3 px (chosen on 23k DOM-labelled gaps: 0 false spaces incl. letter-spaced caps, 71% recall; 82% on the hero-text set), align gaps to character boundaries with an order-preserving edit-distance DP in which existing spaces absorb their own gap; spaces are only added, never removed
metric: text_cer (GT bench, DT_OCR=rapidocr; composite 0.8678 -> 0.8740, 16/24 cases better, none worse)

case: restore_spaces first version on correctly spaced rendered text
symptom: 'Googl e Workspace', 'LABEL T EXT', 'FRI DAY': the fix made correct text worse (rendered lines, Google Sans Text buckets: exact match ~52/56 -> 20-26/56)
root_cause: big gaps that already held a model-emitted space were re-assigned to the nearest letter boundary; thresholds were guessed, and pixel-rounded 2 px letter gaps at 11-12 px passed a ratio-only test
fix: existing spaces are alignment targets; gap may stay unexplained (snap penalty); absolute excess over the median letter gap; regression tests test_restore_spaces_never_corrupts_correct_text

symptom: with RapidOCR's orientation classifier off, the 'mail' icon at (16,744) was read as text 'α' (node recall -4.8 pt on the case)
root_cause: the angle classifier also normalises tiny glyph crops of the second-chance pass; skipping it changes what icon blobs read as
fix: keep use_cls on by default (perceive.ocr.rapid.use_cls = 1)

case: machine without Google Chrome (Linux CI, containers)
symptom: every render raises (channel='chrome' hard-coded); after one failed launch the process keeps a started Playwright driver and later calls cannot recover
root_cause: no fallback and no teardown on launch failure
fix: launch_browser tries DT_BROWSER (channel or executable path) or chrome -> bundled chromium; on failure the driver is stopped and the error names the fix (playwright install chromium / install-deps / DT_BROWSER)

symptom: generated file with no build step: an agent that deletes or updates @material/web cannot rebuild it

fix: npm run build:mwc (esbuild --bundle --minify --format=iife) reproduces the tracked bundle byte-for-byte; test compares bytes

symptom: pulls opencv-python (GUI) next to opencv-python-headless; both own cv2/ and the GUI build needs libGL.so.1 on headless Linux
root_cause: rapidocr's own dependency
fix: setup.sh reinstalls opencv-python-headless last on Linux; dt doctor detects both and prints the command

case: synthetic: two disjoint illustrations, each 20% of a 400x300 screen (tests/test_refine.py::test_raster_budget_holds_when_rasters_are_batched)
symptom: rasterised area 40% of the screen with refine.raster.budget_frac 0.35
root_cause: each raster hypothesis checks the budget against the current document only; the optimizer batches independent hypotheses into one render, so two in-budget rasters are applied together
fix: the raster edits re-check the budget inside apply (on the candidate document) and become no-ops once it is used up; the optimizer's _helpful pass drops the no-op member

case: synthetic: illustration inside a mapped Card instance (test_raster_never_painted_inside_a_component)
symptom: a region raster was inserted as a child of the Card instance; the export drops instance children when the library component resolves, so the loss gain is not in the Figma output
root_cause: _raster_region_hyps treated an 'instance' that contains the region as a plain container to keep, and _deepest_frame picks instances as the parent
fix: containers around a region must be component-free; no raster whose parent or any ancestor has a component; node rasters refuse boxes inside any component (_covers_editable)

case: synthetic: 20px headline drawn over a colourful hero illustration (test_dark_text_over_colourful_art_is_not_a_logo_and_critique_is_pure, test_raster_never_bakes_or_removes_editable_text)
symptom: the dark headline was classified as a logo (hue spread 90 = threshold); critique wrote meta.logo=True onto its input document, the hero crop baked the headline in, and a later region raster deleted the 20px text node
root_cause: _glyph_hue_spread segments glyphs against the crop-border median, which on a textured backdrop takes the backdrop's hues for the glyphs; _logo_hyps mutated ctx.doc so the false logo flag persisted and unlocked _raster_ok for later region rasters; node rasters never checked non-descendant text under their box
fix: logo test requires a flat border (refine.raster.logo_flat_border of the crop border within logo_bg_dist of its median); the logo flag travels in the edit (logo_id), never on the document; node rasters refuse a box covering more than refine.raster.overlap_frac of an editable text/component outside the subtree (the validator's text_under_raster rule)

symptom: gmail mobile: wordmark detected (hue spread 150) but never proposed; keep: the wordmark raster was accepted with the OCR box, which misses the 'G' (crop x 40..219, ink starts at 24), so the G disappeared from the render
root_cause: the logo raster used the text node box: 18.6 px tall (< refine.raster.min_side 20) on gmail and clipped by OCR on both; the logo raster also paid the full text-term penalty because the doc lost the text
fix: _logo_ink_box grows the crop over the target ink (gaps <= refine.raster.logo_gap text heights) plus refine.raster.logo_pad; the image keeps meta.alt_text and the refine text term counts it

case: any run with a 'missing' or region-raster insert
symptom: same input twice -> different documents and histories (inserted node ids differ)
root_cause: inserted nodes kept uuid4 ids from perceive_region / Node()
fix: _stable_ids: ids derived from (kind, parent, index, type, box, text), unique within the document

symptom: per-trial evaluate (Lab of both full images, SSIM, phase correlation, residual regions, per-node errors, Levenshtein text term) took 75 s of a 176 s run
root_cause: every trial re-evaluated the whole screen although only the changed pixels can change the ΔE map, and SSIM/alignment/regions are only read for accepted states
fix: _State.score patches the diff map in the full-width row band of changed pixels (bit-identical: column crops drift ~1e-5 ΔE in rgb2lab) and re-reduces mean/frac_bad; accept completes the report; text term memoised on (lines, texts); refine.opt.incremental=False restores full evaluation

symptom: 23 tests fail off the reference Mac: OCR merges words ('lineoftext'), misses badges, splits punctuation differently; icon pose/atlas matches and font-size fits drift with Linux font rasterisation; refine recovery thresholds and the gt render oracle move
root_cause_hypothesis: perception constants (OCR post-processing, size/weight fits, icon acceptance ΔE, refine margins) were calibrated on one engine (macOS Vision) and one rasteriser (Chrome on macOS)
suggested_fix: per-platform calibration profiles (params overlay per OCR backend + rasteriser) tuned with dt train on runner shards; text post-processing that does not assume Vision's word segmentation

case: CI run 37698183105: macos-latest (older macOS Vision, Chrome)
symptom: badge digits not found, ' / ' spacing differs ('5/ month'), '31' inside a calendar glyph lost, one raster-guard case
root_cause_hypothesis: Vision results differ across macOS versions (word boundaries, small-text recall); the pipeline relies on exact Vision segmentation in places
suggested_fix: make OCR post-processing robust to word segmentation differences (character-level spacing from ink, not word boxes); second-chance OCR thresholds per engine version
